title: Breaking: The Birds Are Spelling Things
description: A starling murmuration freezes over the town at dusk and resolves into legible words. Ronnie covers it like a sky emergency, but the flock keeps scooping the broadcast, spelling each thing a beat before anyone in the studio can say it, right up to the one thing about Ronnie nobody was supposed to say on air.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: We're cutting away from the regular hour on Snazzie FM. This is breaking sky. A starling murmuration has frozen over the town at dusk, and folks, it is no longer moving like birds. It is moving like words.

lines.speaker: rhonda
lines.text: Okay, so, good news, Ronnie. I have the radar up, and this is a textbook murmuration. Thousands of starlings, totally normal flocking behavior. Nothing to worry about.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: And does your textbook murmuration spell anything, Rhonda?

lines.speaker: rhonda
lines.text: No. <p:0.3> They do not spell. They swirl. It's an aesthetic thing, it's the evening light, it's pareidolia, your brain just WANTS to see a word.

lines.speaker: todd
lines.text: Yeah, hi, Ronnie. So. <p:0.3> I'm up on the roof, and they're spelling something. It's a, um. <p:0.4> It's an R. And an A. And an I. And an N. <p:0.3> Rain. It says rain.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Rain. <p:0.3> They spelled rain. <p:0.3> Folks, I'm declaring an Aerial Advisory, tier one. Rhonda, is it going to rain?

lines.speaker: rhonda
lines.text: Okay, so, good news, the front does come in around nine, so yes, light rain overnight, but that's a coincidence, the birds did not, that was MY line. <p:0.4> That was on my radar. I was going to read that.

lines.speaker: caller-chad
lines.text: Yo, this is insane, I'm livestreaming the whole thing right now, the sky is LITERALLY typing. <p:0.3> Birds, if you can hear me, do the thing, spell ChadCast, that's C-H-A-D, please, this is going so viral.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: They are not taking requests, son. Todd, what's the sky saying now?

lines.speaker: todd
lines.text: Okay so it changed. <p:0.3> It says H, I, G, H. <p:0.4> High. And then a number. Five. Eight. <p:0.3> High of fifty eight tomorrow.

lines.speaker: rhonda
lines.text: That was MY line! <p:0.3> High of fifty eight, that is literally my noon forecast, the birds are reading it a beat before I can, how are they ahead of my own radar?

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Rhonda, stay calm. We are upgrading to Aerial Advisory tier two. The flock is now ahead of the meteorologist.

lines.speaker: caller-frank
lines.text: I TOLD you! <p:0.3> I told ALL of you, for nine years, the sky was a screen and you laughed at me. Finally. <p:0.3> Finally the birds are talking, and let me tell you who they answer to. The pigeons. The starlings work for the pigeons.

lines.speaker: rhonda
lines.text: Frank, starlings and pigeons are different birds.

lines.speaker: caller-frank
lines.text: That's what the pigeons want you to think, Rhonda!

lines.speaker: todd
lines.text: Um. <p:0.3> Guys. It's spelling something new. It says T, U, R, K. <p:0.4> Turk. <p:0.3> Turkey. Club. <p:0.3> No mayo.

lines.speaker: rhonda
lines.text: That's my lunch order. <p:0.4> That is my exact lunch order. Turkey club, no mayo, I order it every single day, the sky knows what I get for LUNCH, that is not on any radar, that was MY line and I didn't even SAY it.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Folks, this is no longer weather. The flock is editing the broadcast in real time. Tier three. <p:0.3> Bring in the pets. Cover the bird feeder.

lines.speaker: caller-chad
lines.text: Okay this is actually insane, it just spelled my channel, it spelled ChadCast, wait, no. <p:0.4> No, that says BAD CAST. <p:0.3> The birds reviewed my content. The SKY thinks I'm mid.

lines.speaker: todd
lines.text: Now it's doing four numbers, Ronnie. It's, um. <p:0.3> Four, one, nine, two. <p:0.4> Wait, Rhonda, isn't that your...

lines.speaker: rhonda
lines.text: Do NOT finish that, Todd. <p:0.3> That's my PIN. That is my bank PIN, the sky is spelling my PIN over the post office, change it, I have to change it, the FLOCK has my PIN.

lines.speaker: caller-frank
lines.text: Finally, a system I can trust!

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Frank, it just took her PIN.

lines.speaker: caller-frank
lines.text: And it told us, Ronnie! The pigeons never hid a thing! That's transparency!

lines.speaker: todd
lines.text: Okay it's spelling fast now, I can barely keep, it's, um, it spelled the letter before I, <p:0.3> it's spelling them AS I read them, it's faster than my mouth, Ronnie, it finished my word.

lines.speaker: rhonda
lines.text: It's writing the show now! <p:0.3> It just spelled my next graphic before I loaded it!

lines.speaker: caller-chad
lines.text: It spelled the AD BREAK!

lines.speaker: todd
lines.text: It's spelling a name now!

lines.speaker: rhonda
lines.text: Whose name?

lines.speaker: todd
lines.text: It's, um. <p:0.4> Ronnie, it's spelling the thing. <p:0.3> The thing we are never supposed to say on air about you. <p:0.4> It's spelling your real first name.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Todd. <p:0.4> Do not read the sky.

lines.speaker: rhonda
lines.text: It's already up there, Ronnie. It's, oh. <p:0.3> Oh, wow. It's in big letters. The whole town can read it.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: We're, okay, we are going to a word from our sponsor before the sky finishes that. <p:0.3> Folks, in twenty years on this desk, I have never been beaten to my own... <p:0.4> the sky just spelled GOODNIGHT.

lines.speaker: todd
lines.text: It's holding it, Ronnie. <p:0.3> It's just holding GOODNIGHT over the whole town. It's not moving.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Then I guess we're wrapped. <p:0.4> For the first time in twenty years, folks, this show is running long, because the sky already wrapped it. So, here's a word from our sponsor, Frank's Bait and...

lines.speaker: todd
lines.text: The sky spelled Frank's Bait and Tackle, Ronnie. It beat you to the sponsor.

lines.speaker: caller-frank
lines.text: Finally.
